entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello, I need to make a return. My order number is VF8675309.
Certainly. Let me just pull up that order number... VF8675309. Got it. I see an order for a VeloFit Performance Jersey and a VeloBand Pulse, delivered 16 days ago. What would you like to return?
Yes, that's the one. I'd like to return both of them, actually. The jersey didn't fit right and the Pulse just isn't what I was looking for.
Okay, I can definitely help you with that. Let's start with the jersey. I see it's well within our 90-day return window, so I can process that for you right now. No problem at all.
Great, thank you.

Now, regarding the VeloBand Pulse, I need to double-check the policy on that specific item. Since you ordered two items, they might fall under different guidelines. Would you mind if I place you on a brief one-minute hold?
Uh, sure. I guess so.

Thank you for your patience. I've confirmed our policy. It appears we have separate policies for apparel and electronics. While the jersey has a 90-day policy, the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window due to its electronic components. Since your order was delivered 16 days ago, the pulse is unfortunately outside that return period.
Are you serious? That's ridiculous! Why would there be two different policies on the same order? Ten days is no time at all. That should have been made much clearer when I bought it.

I completely understand your frustration, and I apologize for the confusion. I know that dealing with separate policies for two items in one order can be unexpected. The specific 10-day policy for the Pulse is listed on the product page, but I realize that's easy to overlook.
Easy to overlook is an understatement. So I'm just stuck with it?

While my system won't let me process the return for the Pulse, I do want to make this right for you. For the inconvenience and the confusion over the policy, I'd like to offer you a $50 credit to your VeloFit account. You can still return the jersey for a full refund, and this credit can be used on any future purchase.
Wait, so I get a full refund for the jersey... and a $50 credit on top of that?

That's correct. I've already processed the return authorization for the jersey. You'll get an email with the prepaid shipping label in just a few minutes. I've also just applied that $50 credit to your account, so it's ready to use whenever you'd like.
Oh. Wow. Okay, that's actually a great solution. Thank you, I really appreciate you doing that. That makes up for the hassle.
You're very welcome. I'm glad we could find a resolution you're happy with. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again, Alex.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
